The Wassenaar Arrangement on Export Controls for Conventional Arms and Dual-Use Goods and Technologies, also known simply as the Wassenaar Arrangement , [ 1 ] is a multilateral export control regime governing the international transfer of conventional arms and dual-use goods and technologies . It was established on 12 July 1996 in Wassenaar , Netherlands , as the successor to the Cold War –era Coordinating Committee for Multilateral Export Controls (CoCom), which restricted certain goods to the Eastern Bloc .
